video_title: Jalen Brunson BIGGER Star in New York than Derek Jeter??

quotes.speaker: Jerry Stackhouse
quotes.summary_phrase: Jerry Stackhouse on the history of small guards leading title teams
quotes.excerpt: When you look back in history, there hasn't been a lot of small guards to do it.
quotes.quote: When you look back in history, there hasn't been a lot of small guards to do it. I think you look at Isaiah Thomas, and probably before all of us, but I remember my brothers always talking about Gus Williams with Seattle. He was 6'2", he won a championship, but most of the guys weren't able to get it done. I think it was more about the supporting cast. They just didn't have the supporting cast to beat Shaq and Kobe. Jalen Brunson is different. I don't think any of us saw this when he left Dallas. I thought he was really good, and I've always been a fan of him. I coached against him in AAU when he was 13. What he's been able to do in New York is magical, and if he's able to pull this off, he's definitely going to go down as one of the best small guards ever.

quotes.speaker: Jerry Stackhouse
quotes.summary_phrase: Debating Jalen Brunson's height and the small guard category
quotes.excerpt: Stack, you're not putting Steph in your small guard category along with us.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: Stack, you're not putting Steph in your small guard category along with us.

text_blocks.speaker: Jerry Stackhouse
text_blocks.text: No, man. Stack is about 6'3" to me. Jalen Brunson is 6'2". They just want to argue with me this morning.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: Are you a small guard, Lou? Are you a small guard?

quotes.speaker: Jerry Stackhouse
quotes.summary_phrase: Jerry Stackhouse on why the Knicks and Spurs are both surprising
quotes.excerpt: I think it's great stories. The way the Knicks have kind of come together.
quotes.quote: I think it's great stories. The way the Knicks have kind of come together. I would love to see this story. As a coach, you want to feel like your team has that message of playing well at the right time. Everything is coming together. It's a long season, you're going to have highs and lows, and it feels like they found a way to come together at the right time. Bridges, OG, all these guys are playing at a high level. You're getting great support from some unsung heroes. You have a lot of young guys on the Spurs side, with Wemby being one of those young guys, and then you look at Harper and just a bunch of young talent that you didn't think would come together this fast. When you have a super, super special talent like you have in Wemby, then you have an opportunity for something special like this to happen.

quotes.speaker: Jerry Stackhouse
quotes.summary_phrase: Jerry Stackhouse on Jalen Brunson becoming a New York icon
quotes.excerpt: I don't think Jalen Brunson would pay for a meal in New York ever again.
quotes.quote: I don't think Jalen Brunson would pay for a meal in New York ever again if he pulls this off. The way they've done it, they made a big change last year with Tibbs and bringing in Mike Brown. All of the noise during the course of the year, Mike was getting fired if they didn't get to the finals. New York is one of the toughest places to play and coach because of the fan base and what they expect. Even though they hadn't been to the finals in 30 years, they still expect to win it every year. He's special, he's a winner, and I'd love to see it happen for him.

quotes.speaker: Jerry Stackhouse
quotes.summary_phrase: Jerry Stackhouse reflects on his 2006 NBA Finals suspension
quotes.excerpt: That's one I got to live with. I hate, you know, but I had to.
quotes.quote: That's one I got to live with. I hate, you know, but I had to. I mean, they talked about it. I thought it was going to be worse. You got to be big fella to the spot, though. Either that or he's going to take you with him. He ain't taking a charge on that. That was my thought process, and I didn't even get kicked out of the game. So I think so, never did I think that I would get suspended for the next game, and that was probably one of the hardest things to do, to sit in the hotel and watch your team. I was having a hell of a series up until that point, and now not to be able to help your team. I just think it was still the format, man. I hate that format. I'm glad we went back to it. There's no way you get to the finals and have the best record in the season and you have a chance of coming back home down.
